besluite.fout: The block opens a second sentence with the same long subject, and 'lyk so' at the end links back to the definition only loosely.
besluite.rede: Fronting 'So' is the natural Afrikaans order, ties the sentence to the definition just given and avoids the repeated opening without moving the meaning.
Placing the second phrase after the verb is natural Afrikaans; the proposal pushes the verb far to the end and is harder for a Grade 5 reader.
